content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to connect to a PLC from [company_name], but I get the error 'unable to access the remote device.' I've attached some screenshots of the error. I'm using a PLC with reference [article_no], hardware type [product_name] ([version_no]).

The device [article_no] is actually the current [product_name] [version_no], not the standard version you mentioned. For this model, you'll need [product_name] [version_no] if you want to communicate between the PLC and the software. It also looks like your firmware is not updated—the screenshot shows version [version_no]. You can download the necessary update for the software to [product_name] [version_no], and the firmware update from here: firmware update for [product_name] [version_no] devices and service pack for [product_name] [version_no].

Which should I download? Options are: the complete upgrade package for [product_name], [product_name], and firmware update for [product_name] [version_no]: [document] (5.1 GB, SHA-256); download for [product_name] [version_no]: [document] (1.2 GB, SHA-256); download for firmware update for [product_name] [version_no]: [document] (13.7 MB, SHA-256).

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced trouble connecting to their [product_name] ([version_no], article number [article_no]), with an error indicating remote device access failure. Another user identified the correct model and firmware requirements and suggested relevant updates for both software and hardware. After following these instructions and installing the updates, the connectivity issue was resolved.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward connectivity between [product_name] hardware and matching software versions, without version mismatches or unclear error messaging.
